# Feature Request: `bun test` --exclude / --include for file paths (use case: gating live network canary tests)
...
Bun's test runner has no path-level include/exclude flag. Two prior issues flag this gap:
...
Bun's default test matcher requires `.{test,spec,_test,_spec}.` in the filename. Naming live test files `*.livetest.ts` (no `.test.` substring) makes them naturally invisible to `bun test`. A separate script picks them up by explicit positional path:

[test]
exclude = [\"**/*.live.test.ts\", \"**/__fixtures__/**\"]
